import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0].strip())
    text = data[1].strip() if len(data) > 1 else ""

    inside_words = []
    current_word = []
    outside_length = 0
    max_outside_length = 0
    inside_parentheses = False

    i = 0
    while i < n:
        ch = text[i]

        if ch == '(':
            if outside_length >= max_outside_length:
                max_outside_length = outside_length
            outside_length = 0
            inside_parentheses = True
        elif ch == ')':
            inside_parentheses = False
            if current_word:
                inside_words.append(''.join(current_word))
                current_word.clear()
        elif inside_parentheses:
            if ch != '_':
                current_word.append(ch)
            elif current_word:
                inside_words.append(''.join(current_word))
                current_word.clear()
        elif ch != '_':
            outside_length += 1
            if i == n - 1 and outside_length >= max_outside_length:
                max_outside_length = outside_length
        else:  # ch == '_' and not inside parentheses
            if outside_length >= max_outside_length:
                max_outside_length = outside_length
            outside_length = 0

        i += 1

    print(f"{max_outside_length} {len(inside_words)}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
